report.summary: Patient P-D009 (age 73, Medicare Advantage Lakeshore Senior PPO, transport benefit unknown) needs transport options. Home tract 17031720500 has minimal vehicle-access barriers (0.4% no-vehicle, 26 transit stops within 800m, all with early service). Eligibility check: not Medicaid, so Medicaid Ride Line is not applicable; Kidney Care Rides requires an external eligibility lookup with patient identifiers (name/DOB/zip) not available here, so not verified. Senior Shuttle West is age-eligible (60+) and free for medical appointments on weekdays 7 AM–5 PM. ADA paratransit is an option but certification takes up to 21 days, so it is a longer lead-time option.
